name: barbell hip thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the long side of a bench and a loaded barbell across your hips.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar in place with both hands.
Push through your heels and raise your hips until your torso and thighs form a straight line, with your shoulder blades resting on the bench.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower your hips back toward the floor under control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
